description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the LogNode interface and wraps Android's native Log utility to allow logging with additional chaining support. It facilitates logging messages and exceptions, and passes log data to the next node in a linked list of log handlers.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that implements LogNode to send logs to Android's native Log system, supporting chaining to subsequent LogNode instances.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to which log data will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with specified priority and tag, appending exception details if provided, then forwards the log to the next node in the chain.
